I may be the odd one out, but I contacted Mr. Nemo on Wednesday evening, asking if he could keep my Beagle the following Saturday. I explained that it was an extraordinary situation: I live in Reggio Emilia, I'm going to Milan for an event, and I'd prefer to leave him with a human instead of alone at the kennel. Inspired by the great reviews and the positive impression he'd made on the phone, we confirmed everything during that call. We agreed to speak again on Friday (the day before), just to better arrange the schedule (which we'd already discussed, anyway). On Friday at 10 p.m., I texted Mr. Nemo, apologizing for the late hour, but confirming the schedule we'd already discussed on the phone. The surprise was that Mr. Nemo had already made another commitment, accusing me of having disappeared and of not being able to stoop to the level of contacting me before considering other commitments. He changed his story several times about his commitment, even telling me that he'd considered taking my dog ​​to a friend's garden in Rho, without even being properly equipped to transport the dog in the car, and yet this was completely off the mark with the agreed-upon plans. Mr. Nemo professed great honesty during our first phone call, but proved different in reality and continued to insist that it was my fault for looking for other dog boarding facilities and that I would be writing to him so late. In essence, he decided that the confirmation given over the phone was no longer valid, because "everyone does that anyway." Instead, I had completely trusted him and found myself looking for a dog boarding facility on a Saturday morning. Furthermore, since he talks about how much he does it out of love and that's why he charges so little, I even told him there would be no problem paying him more. I can't publish our conversation, but Mr. Nemo wasn't even apologetic about the predicament he put me in while trying to find a solution for the same day.
Kind and helpful staff. Great expertise and loving care for furry creatures. Highly recommended. Elisa
